purpose: Non-admission discovery of original industrial and built-environment providers found by inspecting NCCS mining and GFDRR Urban Validation configuration sources; no asset bytes, approved rights or scientific admission.

entries.name: PANGAEA Maus Global-scale Mining Polygons Version 2
entries.spatial_scope: Global locations within sampled mining areas; not complete mines or ownership
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 44,929 polygons, 101,583 square km; GPKG, CSV and grids at 30 arc seconds / 5 arc minutes / 30 arc minutes; area in square kilometres
entries.note: NCCS original mining README cites the PANGAEA v2 DOI and 30 arc-second global_miningarea_v2_30arcsecond.tif as its industry allocation grid. Original PANGAEA page specifies CC BY-SA 4.0, whereas secondary EC Africa Knowledge Platform catalog shows CC BY 4.0: original provider terms are authoritative, but exact selected asset and third-party source imagery rights require review. Derived from visual interpretation of 2019 Sentinel-2, with 34,820 S&P mining location sample/10-km buffer and supplementary Google/Bing viewing; spatial selection and human judgement bias apply. Validation reported 88.3% accuracy and 0.87 F1. Mining polygons/area are not unique facility owners, production or insured TIV.

entries.name: Microsoft AI for Good global temporal building density and height COGs
entries.provider: Microsoft AI for Good / Microsoft Buildings
entries.spatial_scope: Global ~100 m public raster for two snapshots; 40 m quarterly tiles cover five named regions only
entries.temporal_scope: Global 2020 Q4 and 2023 Q4; selected-site quarters 2020 Q2 through 2025 Q2
entries.resolution_or_granularity: GeoPackage tile index at https://opendata.aiforgood.ai/building-density/tile_index.gpkg, COG two bands: density 0..1 and height_norm 0..1 (multiply by 100 metres), nodata -1; 100 m global grids
entries.note: GFDRR urban_validation uses original Microsoft TEMPO tile_index.gpkg; original microsoft/buildings README pins v1 (2020q4 and 2023q4) and spatial/temporal band semantics. Derived from PlanetScope quarterly imagery via machine learning; not observed roof polygons, floor area or insured TIV. MIT repository LICENSE is software permission and does not automatically grant redistribution/commercial rights to third-party Planet imagery or all generated data layers. Record selected quarter, tile coordinates, EPSG:3857 index, COG geotransform and exact URL before model work.

entries.name: Austrian World Mining Data 2026 mineral commodity production statistical tables
entries.provider: Republic of Austria Federal Ministry of Finance
entries.spatial_scope: 168 producing countries, 65 mineral commodities; reporting completeness country dependent
entries.temporal_scope: Edition 2026: production years 2020-2024; historical editions separate
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Annual official report PDF and Excel chapters 6.1-6.6 with national production by commodity and comparison tables
entries.note: Original Austrian ministry page identifies World Mining Data 2026 as current edition and associated Excel tables, based on national surveys, BGS/USGS crosschecks and some explicitly estimated production. NCCS mining code cites WorldMiningData 2021 for ROW value allocation, not the 2026 edition: later 2020-2024 figures cannot silently replace WIOD 2011 production values or retrospective original 2021 model inputs. Production tonnage or economic activity is not replacement cost/insured value; datafile licence, units and prices require original review.
